mgmt_bio.text: Enrique K. Razon Jr. leads International Container Terminal Services, Inc. (ICTSI) as its top executive, serving as a director of the company since December 1987 and its chairman since 1995, holding the roles of chairman of the board and president; external profiles describe him as chairman and chief executive officer of the Manila-listed port-handling company. ICTSI was incorporated in 1987 by the Razon and Soriano groups to bid for the Manila International Container Terminal, and after the 1988 contract win Razon led the terminal's development program. The company now manages and operates ports and terminals across roughly 20 countries.

sentences.quote: The company currently operates across 19 countries and describes itself as the world's largest independent terminal operator.
sentences.text: ICTSI, the world's largest independent ports operator, handles 34 container terminals in 20 countries across six continents and is the most valuable company listed on the Philippine Stock Exchange.
First-half 2026 volumes rose 16% to 8.12 million TEU, port revenues 27% to $1.92 billion, EBITDA 24% to $1.23 billion and recurring net income 25% to $604.7 million.

sentences.quote: Excluding those additions and the disposal of Yantai International Container Terminal in China, underlying throughput increased by just 1%, underlining how much of the lift came from recent acquisitions.
sentences.text: Growth is acquisition-led: new terminals in Durban and Batam drove the gains, while underlying throughput excluding them and the Yantai disposal rose just 1%.
A $740 million 2026 capex programme funds expansion at Contecon Manzanillo, Manila, Mindanao, southern Luzon, Brazil and DR Congo, plus projects in Honduras, Melbourne and Guayaquil.
Funding is supported by a $1 billion BDO term loan, with total debt of $3.37 billion and 91% of long-term loans maturing from 2028.
